summary: Layer 1B expands the node away from headline utilities and SMR developers toward fuel-cycle bottlenecks and nuclear-adjacent compliance gates. The highest-evidence reference name remains Centrus Energy for HALEU/enrichment. The underfollowed lane adds Solstice Advanced Materials as a newly public uranium-conversion chokepoint, Mirion Technologies as a nuclear measurement/radiation-safety gatekeeper for SMRs and regulated operations, and ASP Isotopes as a speculative small-cap HALEU/isotope-enrichment option whose evidence is still mostly project-development and partnership-stage rather than operating-scale proof.
